coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run or drawn rule: its x extent, from 14 pt above the line to 1.5 pt under it. Cell or box: its drawn edges. Tick box: the printed square. Picture pages: the picture's pixels through the page's drawing matrix.

signing.kind: investor (and joint owner) completes pages 5-9 and signs and dates pages 8-9; the broker-dealer officer and registered representative sign page 9; the company accepts on page 10 (company use only)

sure_per_page.6: sure; section 2 asks to check a box for additional investments but no box is printed, so none is recorded
sure_per_page.7: places sure; the Home/Business and Telephone No. captions under two rules are read as two rows (doubt on each)

1: prospectus date in the acknowledgement sentence (the issuer completes it before sending)
9: area-code parentheses after the Telephone No. captions (part of the caption)
